title: CurDKV: value-guided KV compression

current.name: CurDKV
current.fullTitle: Value-Guided KV Compression for LLMs via Approximated CUR Decomposition
current.authors: Ayan Sengupta, Siddhant Chaudhary, Tanmoy Chakraborty
claims: Introduces value-aware CurDKV for KV compression.
Uses CUR leverage scores approximated with Gaussian random projections.

startingStrategy.name: Attention-based KV eviction
startingStrategy.summary: Problem family from the CurDKV paper; not asserted as a single invented ancestor.

a.name: SnapKV
a.summary: Selects prompt positions using attention patterns for each attention head.

a.name: ChunkKV
a.summary: Retains semantic chunks as a KV compression strategy.

a.name: H2O
a.summary: Uses recent tokens and heavy hitters in KV cache management.

a.name: StreamingLLM
a.summary: Keeps attention sink tokens and a recent window. This is not directly interchangeable with compression scoring.

m.name: Gaussian random projection
m.summary: Random projection approximation used for CUR leverage scores in CurDKV.

m.name: Sparse CountSketch
m.summary: Sparse randomized sketch family; a possible substitution to investigate, not a claim of improved efficiency.

m.name: Structured orthogonal / SRHT
m.summary: Structured orthogonal transform family; a possible substitution to investigate, not a claim of improved efficiency.

m.name: Leverage score SVD baseline
m.summary: SVD-based leverage score computation as a comparison baseline; not a claim of better efficiency.

caveats: Source-backed claims apply to the individual cited papers, not causal lineage unless the paper says so.
Every A × M combination in this explorer is an untested research-design candidate.
Compatibility is a structural heuristic gate, not evidence of validity or performance.
No claim is made about private cognition.
